title: Shopping now starts with AI, and our store must be ready for agents
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini; Newegg adopted Google UCP checkout; Amex set agent-purchase authorization rules.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming the front door to buying tech
points.detail: Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini, Newegg went live on UCP checkout and Amex introduced authorized agent purchases. We should check feed, content and checkout readiness.

points.headline: AI-led discovery is mainstream and converts better
points.detail: NIQ finds 55% of consumers use AI in discovery; Shopify data shows AI discovery converts better than search. We should make our catalog AI-readable and track AI-sourced traffic separately.

points.headline: PC volumes are collapsing while prices rise
points.detail: Gartner reports Q3 2026 PC shipments down 22.4% with component costs lifting ASPs; DigiTimes reports a drop above 20%. We should plan pricing, stock and promotions for a smaller, costlier market.

points.headline: Holiday demand is growing but rivals set the sale calendar
points.detail: Adobe forecasts record $275.1B US online holiday sales; Prime Big Deal Days drove nearly $10B and lifted Walmart. We should align promotions and inventory with competitor sale windows.
